improvement.name: stat-validated evidence summary cache
improvement.problem: Repeated evidence-history reads reparsed every finalized agent-summary.json even when summaries were unchanged.
implementation: Keep a process-local cache for the active artifacts root only.
Validate every cache reuse against dev, inode, byte size, mtimeNs, and ctimeNs from bigint stat metadata.
Re-read changed summaries, prune deleted runs, and preserve malformed/incomplete-run skipping.
Preserve the existing full directory enumeration and bounded 32-worker scan; no run count cap or hidden filtering was introduced.
Return structured clones so caller mutation cannot poison cached nested summary state.
Keep agent-summary.json as authoritative raw state; no persistent derived database or stale index was introduced.
acceptance: Exact output parity with the pre-change direct-read algorithm on a 2,000-run fixture.
Cache invalidates after a summary changes and after a run is deleted.
Caller mutation of returned nested data cannot affect future reads.
Material median and p95 repeated-read improvement on Linux and Windows.
Full affected Ferrum CI remains green.

challengePass.rationale: A persistent database, filesystem watcher, or external analytical service would add stale-derived-state or dependency risk without evidence of a second current bottleneck. The stat-validated in-process cache already cuts repeated evidence-history median and p95 by more than 50 percent on both Linux and Windows while keeping raw JSON authoritative and output complete.

nextCursor: Benchmark an optional node:sqlite derived index only when a real multidimensional filter/search workload exceeds the new list cache.
Prototype a compact cross-run index keyed by source/build/artifact/attestation identity only if it reduces measured lookup or agent round trips.
Use the existing Perfetto sidecar for timing correlation before introducing a second trace/query backend.
guardrails: No evidence run caps, no skipped directories, no reduced artifacts, and no stale-cache success path.
Raw agent-summary.json files remain authoritative; derived cache state is process-local and disposable.
Every reuse is stat-validated and changed/deleted summaries are observed on the next call.
Existing manifest SHA-256 verification and all real-runtime acceptance lanes remain unchanged.

publication.verification: Canonical bytes are hashed locally; GitHub blob identity and Drive export/embedded JSON are independently re-read after publication.
